title: 第20章 英雄的归来第21章 英雄的梦想
content_zh:
又收好另一个陷阱后，两人快步走回先前休息的洞穴。
“咱只能走这么远了，先把这头狼处理下。”凯斯嘭一声将冬狼的尸体摔在地上。
光是听声音，就能知道刚才这半兽人承受的重量有多恐怖了。
“皮、牙齿和爪子，只要这些就行了。”
“咱以前处理过冬狼，比你懂点，老弟。”凯斯故意板着脸，不过很快，他的脸抽了两下，还是憋不住露出一张狰狞的笑脸。
半兽人轻咳了两声，“快来搭把手，把这条腿抬起来。”
“看来某人想维持所谓‘老大尊严’的想法失败咯。”柯林调侃两句，上前扶住冬狼的前腿。
在他的帮助下，凯斯拿着锋利的小刀飞快地处理着冬狼。
就算是半兽人的动作相当娴熟，力气也足够摆弄冬狼的尸体，剥下冬狼皮毛也花了一个多小时。
洞穴里一下就充满了阵阵血腥味。
“可惜了，要不是这些伤，这块皮还能卖更高的价。”凯斯感叹着。
柯林催促道：“快点吧，千万别引来什么野兽。”
“真要这样，那咱也不活了。”
凯斯边干活边絮叨着：“想想咱们这趟都遇到了什么吧，说是没什么危险的商路上遇到了狼群，然后采药的时候正好撞上哥布林，设了个陷阱反而被冬狼埋伏……”
“好像确实有够倒霉的。”
“何止，咱都感觉你也是个被女神诅咒的倒霉蛋，不过这次下手的是命运女神。”凯斯说。
“所以怪我吗？”
“咱自己走的时候可没这么倒霉。”
柯林一时语塞。
将冬狼皮革完整剥下的凯斯抖了抖这次的战利品，沾满狼血的生皮相当厚实，只是上面有很多破口，其中被柯林用【翠炎剑】砍出来的尤为明显。

“再这么仔细一看，皮的状态也太差了……不过十几个金币也是卖得出去的，咱的部落就经常有人来收皮货。”凯斯再也憋不住，笑出一口的尖牙锐齿。
“为这十几个金币冒风险也是值得的。”柯林说道。
“别人想冒这风险还没路子呢，随便去码头抓一把，有得是人乐意和咱俩交换的，哪怕会丢掉性命。”
凯斯说：“咱觉得你以前肯定是个公子哥，要不然也不会这么瞻前顾后的，当然，这也不错，毕竟你的瞻前顾后救了咱们好多次啦。”
剥完皮后，两人将冬狼的四只爪子和牙齿取下。
觉得可惜的凯斯又割了几条狼腿上的肉打算带走。
最后也多亏了柯林抢到的哥布林草药包裹，要不然都装不下这些战利品。
零零总总算下来，这些东西也有个两百多斤了，不过凯斯背上后也没感觉太吃力。
天知道这兽人力气有多大。
柯林估计要是他没被女神诅咒的话，处境和战斗力绝对比现在好上不少吧。
两人就这么朝着燧石村出发。
比起来时因为害怕漏过草药而小心翼翼的，这趟也算轻松了点，毕竟除了要担心哥布林和野狼之外，两人也没什么需要时刻注意的东西了。
尽管临近冬天，走出几里路后两人还是累得满头大汗。
一直到傍晚时分，两人才重新踩在人类走出的大道上，很快就走到了燧石村周围。
路边的景色从乱石变成麦田，远处哨塔上旌旗飞舞。
柯林紧绷的精神彻底放松下来。
由于凯斯背上的冬狼生皮实在太大，走在路上的时候柯林频频感到周围射来的眼神。
甚至不少闲得没事干的孩子和好事的村民都跟了上来，只是碍于凶神恶煞的凯斯没敢上前搭话。
又走出不远，一个穿着甲胄、卫兵打扮的家伙走了过来。
“停下！”

他远远喊了一声，快步走来。
卫兵指了指凯斯身上的白色毛皮，“你们背着什么东西？”
content_en:
After closing another trap, the two quickly walked back to the cave where they had rested.
"We can only go so far, let's deal with this wolf first." Case threw the winter wolf's body to the ground with a bang.
Just by listening to the sound, you can tell how terrifying the weight the orc was bearing just now was.
"Hide, teeth and claws, that's all."
"We have dealt with winter wolves before, and we know better than you, brother." Case deliberately kept a straight face, but soon, he slapped his face twice, but he still couldn't help but reveal a ferocious smile.
The orc coughed twice, "Come and help me, lift this leg up."
"It seems that someone's idea of maintaining the so-called 'boss dignity' has failed." Colin joked and stepped forward to hold the winter wolf's front legs.
With his help, Case quickly disposed of the winter wolf with a sharp knife.
Even the half-orc was quite skillful and strong enough to handle the winter wolf's body, and it took more than an hour to peel off the winter wolf's fur.
The cave was immediately filled with the smell of blood.
"It's a pity. If it weren't for these injuries, this piece of skin could be sold for a higher price." Case sighed.
Colin urged: "Hurry up, don't attract any wild beasts."
"If this is really the case, then we won't be able to live anymore."
Case murmured as he worked: "Think about what we encountered on this trip. We encountered wolves on a trade road that was not dangerous, and then we happened to run into goblins while collecting herbs. We set a trap but were ambushed by winter wolves..."
"It seems that he is indeed unlucky enough."
"Moreover, we all feel that you are also an unlucky guy who was cursed by the goddess, but this time it was the goddess of fate who attacked you." Case said.
"So do you blame me?"
"We weren't so unlucky when we left on our own."
Colin was speechless for a moment.
Keith, who had completely peeled off the winter wolf's hide, shook the trophy. The rawhide stained with wolf blood was quite thick, but there were many holes on it, especially those cut by Colin with the [Emerald Flame Sword].
"If you look closely, you can see that the skin is in very bad condition... but it can be sold for a dozen gold coins. People from our tribe often come to collect the skins." Case couldn't hold it in any longer and smiled with sharp teeth.
"It's worth taking the risk for these dozen gold coins," Colin said.
"There is no way for others to take this risk. Just go to the dock and grab a handful. There will be people willing to trade with us, even if it means losing your life."
Keith said: "We think you must have been a young man before, otherwise you wouldn't be so foresight. Of course, this is not bad. After all, your foresight has saved us many times."
After skinning, the two men removed the winter wolf's four claws and teeth.
Feeling pity, Keith cut off the meat from a few more wolf legs and planned to take them away.
In the end, it was also thanks to the package of Goblin herbs that Colin grabbed, otherwise he wouldn't be able to hold these trophies.
After Ling Ling finally got down, these items weighed over two hundred kilograms, but Case didn't feel too strenuous when he carried them on his back.
God knows how powerful this orc is.
Colin estimated that if he had not been cursed by the goddess, his situation and combat effectiveness would definitely be much better than now.
The two of them set off towards Flintstone Village.
Compared to the previous trip where they were cautious because they were afraid of missing the herbs, this trip was a little easier. After all, apart from worrying about goblins and wild wolves, the two of them had nothing to pay attention to at all times.
Even though winter was approaching, the two of them were still exhausted and sweating profusely after walking a few miles.
It wasn't until dusk that the two of them stepped on the road trodden by humans again, and soon walked around the Flint Village.
The scenery on the roadside changed from rocks to wheat fields, with flags flying on the sentry tower in the distance.
Colin's tense spirit completely relaxed.
Because the winter wolf hide on Case's back was too big, Colin frequently felt the glances from around him while walking on the road.
There are even many children who have nothing to doThe friendly villagers all followed him, but Keyes didn't dare to come forward and talk to him because of his fierce appearance.
Not far away, a guy wearing armor and dressed as a guard came over.
"Stop!"
He shouted from afar and walked over quickly.
The guard pointed at the white fur on Case's body, "What are you carrying?"
